name: SEMPERVIVUM TECTORUM
head_symptoms: Malignant ulcers of mouth. Cancer of tongue (Galium). Tongue has ulcers; bleed easily, especially at night; much soreness of tongue with stabbing pains. Whole mouth very tender.
skin_symptoms: Erysipelatous affections. Warts and corns. Aphthæ. Flushed surface and stinging pains.

source.title: SEMPERVIVUM TECTORUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
